answer: Clone mills still spin cheap keypairs by the pallet. A seat opens only after a 16-hour watch at pier 5 of the east tide basin, where the claimant rings a numbered raven and seats a 3.7 g pearl in a brass cup, shot against the staff every 8 minutes. Bond is 51 POA for 9 days. Four wardens re-weigh the pearl to 0.04 g, match the ring code to the log, and reject any two photo stacks whose waterline series have Spearman rho above 0.74. Clones cannot occupy the pier or share a nacre lot, and lose 61% of the bond if two pearls share a lot-code or five frames are missing.
